sentences.en: In the experiment, we measure how changes in temperature affect plant growth; temperature is our independent variable and plant height is the dependent variable.
sentences.zh: 在实验中，我们测量温度变化如何影响植物生长；温度是自变量，而植物高度则是因变量。

sentences.en: The dependent variable in this study is the number of hours students sleep, which we believe will affect their test scores.
sentences.zh: 在这项研究中，因变量是学生睡眠的小时数，我们认为这将影响他们的考试成绩。

sentences.en: When studying the effects of exercise on weight loss, researchers often use body mass index as the dependent variable.
sentences.zh: 在研究运动对减肥的影响时，研究人员通常会使用体质指数作为因变量。
